title: lifecan（生命罐头）
description: 一个增加生命值罐头的简易模组，食用后增加一颗心的生命值上限。A simple mod that adds a "Life Can". Eating it permanently increases your maximum health by one heart.
body:
A simple mod that adds a "Life Can". Eating it permanently increases your maximum health by one heart. It's crafted with a golden apple in the center surrounded by eight iron ingots. The health boost does not reset on death.

增加一个‘生命罐头’的简易模组，食用后增加一颗心的生命值上限，合成方式是中间一个金苹果周围一圈八个铁锭，死亡不会重置生命值上限增加的效果
